title: Exam at USI
description: In questa pagina trovate consigli e risorse utili per la creazione e la gestione degli esami all'USI. Ricordiamo inoltre che: il nostro team di progettiste didattiche è disponibile ad accompagnarvi e consigliarvi nel processo di creazione dei vostri esami o nella loro ri-progetta

blocks.html:
On this page, you will find tips and useful resources for creating and managing exams at USI. We also remind you that:

  • our team of instructional designers is available to support and advise you in the process of creating or redesigning your exams.
  • out team of developers if available for any technical issues related to exams on iCorsi.

We encourage you to book a consultation with us via the USI services portal.

Checklist and Exam Guides

  • Directive on measures regarding on-site computer-based exams starting from the 2023–2024 academic year (in Italian)
  • Instructor checklist for on-site computer-based exams
  • Student checklist for on-site computer-based exams

Useful tools

  • Safe Exam Browser (SEB). Software that allows students to take online exams securely by preventing the use of unauthorized resources during the exam.
  • Turnitin. Software that allows plagiarism checking. You can find more information about Turnitin in our FAQs.

You can find more information about the tools in the “Tools and Platforms” section of our page.

Teaching Tips

A section dedicated to short informational content designed to offer practical and targeted insights into university teaching, including tips focused on assessment.
